question: Show the name, nation and result for the cyclists who did not purchase any racing bike.
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "cyclists" AS SELECT "id" AS "id", "name" AS "name", "nation_result" AS "nation_result" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "purchases" AS SELECT "cyclist_id" AS "cyclist_id", "bike_purchase_combined" AS "bike_purchase_combined" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "products" AS SELECT "id" AS "id", "product_name" AS "product_name", "weight" AS "weight", "price" AS "price", "material" AS "material" FROM table_3;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_purchases_parsed AS
SELECT 
  cyclist_id,
  bike_purchase_combined,
  TRY_CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(bike_purchase_combined, '^(\d+)') AS BIGINT) AS product_id_guess
FROM purchases

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE tmp_racing_flags AS
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT p.cyclist_id,
         pr.product_name,
         CASE WHEN pr.product_name IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_link
  FROM tmp_purchases_parsed p
  LEFT JOIN products pr
    ON pr.id = p.product_id_guess
),
flags AS (
  SELECT j.cyclist_id,
         MAX(CASE 
               WHEN j.product_name IS NOT NULL AND (
                    j.product_name ILIKE '%RACING%' OR
                    j.product_name ILIKE '%RACE%' OR
                    j.product_name ILIKE '%AERO%' OR
                    j.product_name ILIKE '%PRO%' OR
                    j.product_name ILIKE '%TT%' OR
                    j.product_name ILIKE '%TIME TRIAL%'
               ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_racing_purchase
  FROM joined j
  GROUP BY j.cyclist_id
)
SELECT * FROM flags

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH c AS (
  SELECT id AS cyclist_id,
         name,
         SPLIT_PART(nation_result, '|', 1) AS nation,
         SPLIT_PART(nation_result, '|', 2) AS result
  FROM cyclists
),
rf AS (
  SELECT cyclist_id, COALESCE(has_racing_purchase, 0) AS has_racing_purchase
  FROM tmp_racing_flags
)
SELECT c.name, c.nation, c.result
FROM c
LEFT JOIN rf ON rf.cyclist_id = c.cyclist_id
WHERE COALESCE(rf.has_racing_purchase, 0) = 0
ORDER BY c.name
